title: Smart Plug
description: A switchable plug that powers one connected device. Toggling the plug also powers or unpowers the device it is connected to — a cross-Thing effect. The device is named by the `device` property, set per instance, so one annotation serves every plug.

poweredOn.title: Powered On
poweredOn.description: Whether the plug is switched on.

device.title: Connected Device
device.description: Id of the device this plug powers; set per instance.

toggle.title: Toggle
toggle.description: Flip the plug on/off, powering or unpowering the connected device to match.
toggle.vre:effects: poweredOn' = !poweredOn; device.poweredOn' = !poweredOn; output.success = true; output.poweredOn = poweredOn';
